title: GROUND STAMPS THAT STAY
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it (item 12, richer ground). Marks on the floor used to be a short list that faded after 45 seconds and was redrawn every frame. A new ground stamp paints a scorch, a crack, debris or a spent casing straight into the floor itself, so it stays for the whole raid and costs nothing to draw however many there are. Every stamp is remembered, so if the graphics card drops the picture and the floor has to be rebuilt, the marks go back on it. This build is the stamp itself; the next builds use it for casings and explosions. Nothing about play changes.
now: Marks on the ground can now be painted into the floor itself and stay for the whole raid.

edits.anchor: function scarStamp(kind,x,y,o){ return gfxHook('scar'); }   // D: scorch, cracks and debris into G.ground

edits.replacement: if(G&&G.map&&!G.sim){ try{ G.ground=bakeGround(G.map); }catch(e){} try{ gfxScarReplay(); }catch(_gsr){} }   // v23.xx (gfx22): and the stamps the raid left go back on the new floor
